description: Follows Lin Chong from the harassment of his wife and the fabricated White Tiger Hall offense through exile, Lu Zhishen’s rescue, the snowbound fodder depot, and his arrival at Liangshan. Examines official manipulation of evidence, the vulnerability of households, betrayal, and the limits of individual rescue when institutions remain corrupt.
